newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish police warn of Kurd rebel suicide bomber.
newsitem.headline: Turkish police warn of Kurd rebel suicide bomber.

text.p: Police in the central Turkish town of Sivas have warned people to be on the look-out for a female Kurdish rebel believed to be intending a suicide bomb attack, state-run Anatolian news agency reported on Thursday.
"Information has been received that (a woman) could be intending a suicide attack," police chief Celalettin Cerrah was quoted as saying.
Last October, a female Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) guerrilla killed herself and five other people in Sivas when she set off a bomb strapped to her body.
Three policemen who had detained her were among the dead in the incident, on Turkey's Republic Day national holdiday.
Police have released a photograph of the latest potential bomber and set up a telephone hot-line.
More than 24,000 people have died in the almost 13 years of conflict between security forces and the PKK, fighting for Kurdish self rule in southeast Turkey.
